description: Spec 030 (phase 17, SRD Annex H): a dedicated manoeuvre detector, T2's architecture (2 x 128 LSTM, derived features) with the manoeuvre_detector head (one logit; label: the stored course changed within the last 5 min; quiet rows 0; masked BCE), trained from scratch on generator 0.6.0 data with realistic bearing error (seed 238, configs/phase7-ranges.json). Normalisation from this dataset's train split (inputs only). The evaluation job only commits the model; validation (seed 217) and G6 under Annex H's rules (fresh seed 239) are scored with tma-detect and tma-g6 under a later decision that freezes the detector by digest.
